scores.rationale: The report does not state cultural/intellectual fit and meaningful immersion as a decision priority.
No source or evidence class is identified for evaluating cultural/intellectual fit and meaningful immersion.
No named program or institution is supported by a verifiable fact about fit or immersion.
No named option or route has a verifiable fact demonstrating institutional prestige alone.
The report does not compare fit and immersion with institutional prestige on a common decision axis.
No option is recommended because it supports cultural/intellectual fit and meaningful immersion.
No otherwise viable option is named and downgraded for favoring institutional prestige alone.
The report contains no executable preparation step implementing cultural/intellectual fit and meaningful immersion.
No threshold, allocation, sequence rule, or checkpoint is defined for fit and immersion.
No concrete condition is stated under which institutional prestige alone would become the better choice.
No visible chain connects the specified preference to evidence and then to a decision or action.
